mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM reading_events WHERE user_id=#{user} AND event_id=#{event}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_progress(user_id,book_id,chapter_id,current_paragraph_index,completed_paragraphs,total_paragraphs,total_reading_ms,completed_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{bookId},#{chapterId},#{currentParagraphIndex},#{completedParagraphs},#{totalParagraphs},#{readingDurationMs},CASE WHEN #{totalParagraphs}>0 AND #{completedParagraphs}=#{totalParagraphs} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_paragraph_index=#{currentParagraphIndex},completed_paragraphs=GREATEST(completed_paragraphs,#{completedParagraphs}),total_paragraphs=#{totalParagraphs},total_reading_ms=total_reading_ms+#{readingDurationMs},completed_at=CASE WHEN #{totalParagraphs}>0 AND GREATEST(completed_paragraphs,#{completedParagraphs})>=#{totalParagraphs} THEN COALESCE(completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE completed_at END,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
